en: **Greek text.** _Epicteti dissertationes ab Arriano digestae_, editio maior, edited by Heinrich Schenkl, Leipzig, Teubner, 1916. Taken from the [Perseus Digital Library](https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/) (Tufts University), URN `urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0557.tlg001.perseus-grc2`.

**English translation.** George Long, _The Discourses of Epictetus, with the Encheiridion and Fragments_, London, George Bell and Sons, 1890. Taken from the [Perseus Digital Library](https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/), URN `urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0557.tlg001.perseus-eng3`. The footnotes are Long's own and are printed in full at the end of each discourse.

grc: **Τὸ ἑλληνικὸν κείμενον.** _Epicteti dissertationes ab Arriano digestae_, ἔκδοσις μείζων, ἐπιμελείᾳ Heinrich Schenkl, Leipzig, Teubner, 1916· ἐκ τῆς [Perseus Digital Library](https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/) (Tufts University), URN `urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0557.tlg001.perseus-grc2`.

**Ἡ ἀγγλικὴ μετάφρασις.** George Long, _The Discourses of Epictetus, with the Encheiridion and Fragments_, London, George Bell and Sons, 1890· ἐκ τῆς [Perseus Digital Library](https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/), URN `urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0557.tlg001.perseus-eng3`. αἱ δὲ σημειώσεις αὐτοῦ τοῦ Long εἰσὶ καὶ ἐν τῷ τέλει ἑκάστης διατριβῆς κεῖνται.

**Ἡ ἄδεια.** ἄμφω τὰ κείμενα κατὰ τὴν ἄδειαν [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) δίδοται, καὶ ὅδε ὁ τόπος ἐπὶ τοῖς αὐτοῖς αὐτὰ ἐκδίδωσιν.
**Ἡ ἰταλικὴ μετάφρασις.** ὑπὸ GPT-5.6 Sol, μετὰ τῆς Claude Opus 5.0 ἐπικουρίας, ἐκ τοῦ ἑλληνικοῦ κειμένου πεποιημένη, ἔτει 2026 τετελεσμένη.
**Ἡ εἰκὼν τοῦ ἐξωφύλλου.** διὰ τεχνητῆς νοήσεως πεποίηται.
